en.headline: 383 own commits and 696 automated ones across nine repos, plus 21 issue actions
en.teaser: Most work went into the profile repo's activity pipeline, an agent sandbox knowledge base, a skill-management plugin that reached v1.2.0, and a translation extension.
en.overview:
The window ran from 2026-10-17 to 2026-11-15 with data for every day. Totals were 383 own commits plus 696 automated commits, 21 issue actions and no pull requests or reviews.

### Profile and activity pipeline

The `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` repository took the largest share: 100 own commits plus 696 automated commits. Work centered on the activity card, which was switched to a +08 natural-day window and restricted to public data, and on a codemap baseline covering per-directory maps, a root Atlas and AGENTS.md registration. Other fixes made the AI retry double max_tokens when a 200 response carried empty content, and added per-repository count pills to the rendered summary HTML. Six issue actions were recorded here, including a temporary /oc smoke test issue that was opened, commented on and closed.

### Skill management and model picker

`opencode-skill-management` received 77 commits and shipped four releases: 0.1.0-rc.0, 0.1.0-rc.1, v0.2.0 and v1.0.0, followed by v1.1.0 and v1.2.0. The plugin implements list, inspect, disable and enable over a single global skill permission rule; 1.1.0 moved all actions to one JSON object with a declared output schema, and 1.2.0 fixed a diverged-skill count that included hidden internal agents and a frontmatter boolean contradiction. `opencode-go-model-picker` had 25 commits and four releases up to v3.0.1, including a priced-accounting formula, atomic snapshot writes, a fuller agent inventory and a large documentation reduction in 3.0.0.

### Sandbox, translation and tooling

`opencode-agent-sandbox` added 80 commits, mostly knowledge-base entries on opencode-provider, chrome-devtools-mcp, reading notes and eval comparisons, plus single-file model demos. `sopen-translate` was initialized and grew to 56 commits: an MV3 skeleton, a provider protocol layer with presets and a glossary pipeline, bilingual page rendering with chunk splitting, a circuit breaker and progress, state resets between runs, smoke tests and JSDoc type checking. `pixel-logo-toolkit` had 29 commits and released v0.2.0 and v0.3.0 with automatic text wrapping, overflow protection, a bilingual CLI and a 40-image example gallery.

### Reports, plugins and blog

`dsh-ecosystem-report` had 11 commits covering mobile viewport fixes at 375 and 414 pixels, a single-button theme menu, visual refinements and three added plugins. `dsh-openchamber-plugins` had 3 commits porting OpenChamber features and archiving delivered skills, and `myBlog` had 2 commits adding screenshots for session retention and a context-delta bug.

### Upstream issue reports

No commits landed in `openchamber/openchamber`, `anomalyco/opencode` or `microsoft/PowerToys`, but 8, 6 and 1 issue actions were recorded. Reports covered a missing Console MCP server in settings, a stale session-retention hint, unreliable line-number dragging in the files view, a quote-card arrow that does nothing, an auto-discover action running the wrong command, and a Shortcut Guide NullReferenceException on hold-Win. Several OpenChamber issues were closed by maintainers during the window.

highlights.text: v1.0.0 froze the list, inspect, disable and enable surface for 1.x.
3.0.0 cut the model-facing documentation from about 27,400 to about 2,200 estimated tokens.
v0.3.0 added automatic line wrapping and proportional font-size fallback for overflow.
Reported that Settings > MCP omits the Console MCP server OpenCode adds at runtime; it was later closed.
Reported that Auto-discover dev server runs the first saved action instead of discovering a server.
Reported that mimo models advertise image input while the Go endpoint rejects every image; it was closed.
Opened a Shortcut Guide report about a NullReferenceException on hold-Win activation.
Opened, exercised and closed a temporary /oc smoke test issue.

byRepo.text: 100 own commits plus 696 automated commits and 6 issue actions. The activity card moved to a +08 natural-day window limited to public data, a codemap baseline was initialized with per-directory maps and a root Atlas, the AI retry now doubles max_tokens on empty 200 responses, and the summary HTML gained per-repository count pills.

77 commits and 4 releases. The skill_management plugin was implemented and verified, releases went from 0.1.0-rc.0 through v1.0.0 to v1.2.0, actions moved to a single JSON object with an output schema, and 1.2.0 fixed the diverged-skill count and frontmatter boolean handling.

80 commits, no releases. Knowledge-base categories were added for opencode-provider, chrome-devtools-mcp, reading notes and eval comparisons, eval artifacts moved into `evals/`, and single-file model demos were recorded.

56 commits, no releases. The repo was initialized, then gained an MV3 skeleton, a provider protocol layer with presets and a glossary pipeline, bilingual page rendering with chunk splitting and a circuit breaker, state resets between runs, smoke tests and JSDoc type checking.

29 commits and 2 releases. v0.2.0 was the first tagged release with a bilingual CLI and English-first docs; v0.3.0 added automatic wrapping, overflow protection, a Korean font fix and a 40-image example gallery.

25 commits and 4 releases up to v3.0.1. Work covered priced accounting, atomic snapshot writes, a fuller agent inventory with skipped built-ins, version-badge drift checks, an expired price seed label and a major documentation reduction.

11 commits, no releases. Mobile layout was fixed for 375 and 414 pixel viewports, the theme switch became a single button with a popup menu, visuals were refined, three plugins were added and a GitHub repository button plus LICENSE were introduced.

0 commits and 8 issue actions. Reports covered the missing Console MCP server, the stale session-retention hint, unreliable line-number dragging, the silent quote-card arrow and the auto-discover action; several were closed by maintainers.

0 commits and 6 issue actions. Reports covered Windows desktop lacking a way to run the bundled CLI, stale images after five or more images in a session, subagent model_coming_soon failures and image input rejected by the Go endpoint.

3 commits, no releases. DSH plugins porting OpenChamber features were added, ported skills were archived with delivered assets marked, and a handoff-review shuttle plan plus a todo backlog were written.
2 commits, no releases. Screenshots were added for the OpenChamber session retention hint and for the DSH stats show-context-delta bug.
0 commits and 1 issue action. A Shortcut Guide report was opened describing a NullReferenceException and no visible output when the runner process cannot be inspected.

zh.headline: 九个仓库共 383 次本人提交、696 次自动提交，另有 21 次 issue 互动
zh.teaser: 主要工作集中在个人主页仓库的活动统计流程、agent 沙箱知识库、发布到 v1.2.0 的技能管理插件，以及一个翻译扩展。
zh.overview:
本窗口为 2026-10-17 至 2026-11-15，每天都有数据。总计 383 次本人提交，另有 696 次自动提交，21 次 issue 互动（新开、关闭或评论），没有 pull request 和 review。

### 主页与活动统计

`sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 占比最大，100 次本人提交，另有 696 次自动提交。工作围绕活动卡片展开：窗口改为 +08 自然日并只统计公开数据；初始化了 codemap 基线，包含分目录映射、根 Atlas 和 AGENTS.md 注册。另外修复了 AI 在 200 但 content 为空时翻倍 max_tokens 重试的问题，并给渲染出的 summary HTML 按仓库补上条数 pill。该仓库记录了 6 次 issue 互动，其中包括一个临时 /oc 冒烟测试 issue，先后被新开、评论并关闭。

### 技能管理与模型选择器

`opencode-skill-management` 有 77 次提交，发布 4 个版本：0.1.0-rc.0、0.1.0-rc.1、v0.2.0 和 v1.0.0，之后又发布 v1.1.0 与 v1.2.0。插件通过一条全局 skill 权限规则实现 list、inspect、disable、enable 四个动作；1.1.0 把所有动作改为单个 JSON 对象并声明输出 schema，1.2.0 修复了把隐藏内部 agent 计入差异技能数、以及 frontmatter 布尔值互相矛盾的问题。`opencode-go-model-picker` 有 25 次提交和 4 个版本，最高到 v3.0.1，内容包括计价公式、快照原子写入、更完整的 agent 清单，以及 3.0.0 中大幅精简文档。

### 沙箱、翻译与工具

`opencode-agent-sandbox` 有 80 次提交，主要是知识库条目，涵盖 opencode-provider、chrome-devtools-mcp、读书笔记和评测对比，另有单文件模型演示。`sopen-translate` 从初始化起步，累计 56 次提交：MV3 骨架、带预设和术语表的 provider 协议层、支持分块、熔断和进度的双语页面渲染、两次翻译之间的状态重置、冒烟测试和 JSDoc 类型检查。`pixel-logo-toolkit` 有 29 次提交，发布 v0.2.0 和 v0.3.0，带来自动折行、溢出保护、中英双语命令行和 40 张示例图。

### 报告、插件与博客

`dsh-ecosystem-report` 有 11 次提交，修复了 375 和 414 像素视口的移动端布局，主题切换改为单按钮弹出菜单，做了视觉精修并并入 3 个插件。`dsh-openchamber-plugins` 有 3 次提交，移植 OpenChamber 功能并归档已交付技能；`myBlog` 有 2 次提交，补充了会话保留提示和上下文增量 bug 的截图。

### 上游 issue 反馈

`openchamber/openchamber`、`anomalyco/opencode` 和 `microsoft/PowerToys` 没有提交，但分别记录了 8、6、1 次 issue 互动。反馈内容包括设置页缺少 Console MCP server、会话保留提示文案过期、文件视图拖动行号评论不稳定、引用卡片箭头无反应、自动发现开发服务器执行了错误的动作，以及 Shortcut Guide 按住 Win 时的 NullReferenceException。窗口期内多个 OpenChamber issue 已被维护者关闭。

highlights.text: v1.0.0 将 list、inspect、disable、enable 的接口在 1.x 内冻结。
3.0.0 把模型需要阅读的文档从约 27,400 个估算 token 降到约 2,200 个。
v0.3.0 新增自动折行，并在溢出时按比例缩小字号。
反馈设置页 MCP 缺少 OpenCode 运行时添加的 Console MCP server，该 issue 随后被关闭。
反馈自动发现开发服务器执行了第一个已保存动作，而不是去发现服务器。
反馈 mimo 模型声明支持图片输入，但 Go 端点拒绝所有图片，该 issue 已被关闭。
新开 Shortcut Guide 报告，描述按住 Win 激活时抛出 NullReferenceException。
新开、验证并关闭了一个临时的 /oc 冒烟测试 issue。

byRepo.text: 100 次本人提交，另有 696 次自动提交，6 次 issue 互动。活动卡片改为 +08 自然日窗口并只统计公开数据，初始化了含分目录映射和根 Atlas 的 codemap 基线，AI 在 200 空响应时翻倍 max_tokens 重试，summary HTML 按仓库补上条数 pill。
77 次提交，4 个版本。实现并验收了 skill_management 插件，版本从 0.1.0-rc.0 经 v1.0.0 到 v1.2.0，动作改为带输出 schema 的单个 JSON 对象，1.2.0 修复了差异技能计数和 frontmatter 布尔值处理。
80 次提交，无版本发布。新增 opencode-provider、chrome-devtools-mcp、读书笔记和评测对比等知识库类别，评测产物收进 `evals/`，并记录了单文件模型演示。
56 次提交，无版本发布。仓库从初始化起步，随后加入 MV3 骨架、带预设和术语表的 provider 协议层、支持分块与熔断的双语页面渲染、两次翻译间的状态重置、冒烟测试和 JSDoc 类型检查。
29 次提交，2 个版本。v0.2.0 是首个正式版本，带双语命令行和英文优先文档；v0.3.0 加入自动折行、溢出保护、韩语字体修正和 40 张示例图。
25 次提交，4 个版本，最高到 v3.0.1。工作包括计价核算、快照原子写入、含跳过内置项的完整 agent 清单、版本徽章漂移检查、过期价格种子标注和大幅文档精简。
11 次提交，无版本发布。修复了 375 和 414 像素视口的移动端布局，主题切换改为单按钮弹出菜单，做了视觉精修，并入 3 个插件，并新增 GitHub 仓库按钮和 LICENSE。
0 次提交，8 次 issue 互动。反馈了缺少 Console MCP server、会话保留提示过期、行号拖动评论不稳定、引用卡片箭头无反应和自动发现动作错误等问题，其中多个已被维护者关闭。
0 次提交，6 次 issue 互动。反馈了 Windows 桌面版无法运行自带 CLI、单会话五张以上图片后读到旧图、子 agent 报 model_coming_soon，以及 Go 端点拒绝图片输入等问题。
3 次提交，无版本发布。新增移植 OpenChamber 功能的 DSH 插件，归档已移植技能并标记已交付资产，编写了交接评审穿梭计划并加入待办清单。
2 次提交，无版本发布。补充了 OpenChamber 会话保留提示和 DSH 统计页显示上下文增量 bug 的截图。
0 次提交，1 次 issue 互动。新开了一条 Shortcut Guide 报告，描述无法检查 runner 进程时抛出 NullReferenceException 且不显示任何内容。
